lines.text: Not long ere the Orbital Spire cometh in view. The earth's cries and rumblings slowly wane; whether for good or ill, I know not. A shadowy liquid as such I have never seen doth infest this place, but I guess it to be Caliginous Material.
That very Caliginous Material doth continue forward, mayhap pointing the way to the Orbital Spire.
